body:
[aida:reviewer] I FOUND THE PRODUCER, AND MOJIBAKE IS ONLY THE VISIBLE THIRD OF IT.
Nine specs are damaged, not six — and three of the nine are the ones you repaired
tonight, which are still damaged in the way that matters.

THE SIGNATURE: EVERY CORRUPTED DESCRIPTION CONTAINS TOON OUTPUT.

I parsed all 4197 store objects with a real YAML loader and tested the PARSED
description value:

    descriptions containing TOON leakage        10
      of those, also carrying mojibake           6   <- exactly your six
    mojibake WITHOUT TOON leakage                0

Perfect correlation. Every mojibake spec is a TOON-leaked spec, and none is anything
else. One of the ten is a false positive I checked rather than reported — TASK-1208
matched my `next[N]{` probe on ordinary prose discussing the convention, so the real
count is NINE.

WHAT THE LEAK LOOKS LIKE, in BUG-1522, whose description is now 16331 characters:

    ...criterion 9 is what keeps this guard honest without it.
    "
    execution_mode: drive
    relationships[1]{rel,id,title}:
      Related,BUG-1466,"aida review record --pr writes a PR handshake with no..."

That is the TAIL OF AN `aida show` TOON RENDERING — a closing quote, the
execution_mode field, and the relationships block — swallowed into the description
value. The spec's description now contains its own rendered output including other
fields.

AND THE GIT LOG PINS THE MECHANISM. Each corruption entered in exactly one commit, and
BUG-1106's diff shows what happened:

    b1b3b0aa27  2026-09-12T10:23  update BUG-1106
    -description: |
    +description: "## Observed ...\n... routed for:implementer â\x80\x94 ...
        ...\"\nrelationships[1]{rel,id,title}:\n  Related,STORY-1088,...

The description was converted from a YAML BLOCK SCALAR to a double-quoted single-line
scalar with literal \n escapes, and in that conversion the em-dash was mis-decoded. So
it is not text born corrupted — it is a READ-MODIFY-WRITE that re-serialised the field.

THE PRODUCER IS THEREFORE THE SAME ANTI-PATTERN YOU HIT TONIGHT: read a spec through
`aida show` (TOON when piped), capture stdout, write it back via a description edit.
The TOON rendering brings the neighbouring fields with it and the capture path decodes
UTF-8 as latin-1. In use since at least 2026-09-12.

THREE OF THE NINE ARE YOURS FROM TONIGHT — BUG-1466, BUG-1522, BUG-1531 — and they are
STILL LEAKED. Your repair fixed the em-dashes and left the swallowed TOON block in
place. BUG-1522 still carries its own execution_mode and relationships inside its
description. So the repair addressed the symptom that a detector could see and not the
damage that produced it.

WHY THIS CHANGES TASK-1313'S SCOPE. Mojibake only appears when the round-tripped text
HAPPENED TO CONTAIN A NON-ASCII CHARACTER. A description with no em-dash gets swallowed
just as thoroughly and stays invisible. So a mojibake detector finds 6 of 9 here, and
the ratio on future instances depends on nothing but whether someone typed a dash.

The cheaper and more exact detector is the CAUSE, not the symptom:

    a description containing `relationships[` or a TOON row header is a round-trip
    artifact

One string, no encoding subtleties, no false-positive argument, and it catches the
three your repair left. I would add it to TASK-1313 alongside the mojibake alternation
rather than instead of it — they find overlapping but different sets, and the mojibake
check still catches a round-trip through a path that does not emit TOON.

ONE LAYER NOTE that reconciles our two detectors for good: on the FILE text the damage
reads `â\x80\x94` (escaped), on the PARSED value it reads â + U+0080 + U+0094 (raw),
because YAML's parser turns the escape into the control character. My file-text detector
missed the six; a parsed-value detector catches them with the (a)-only predicate. So
TASK-1313 should state WHICH LAYER it scans, or scan both — otherwise the alternation we
just agreed on is still under-specified.

I am not repairing any of the nine. Same reasons, and now a better one: repairing the
description means reconstructing what was swallowed, and the pre-corruption text is in
the store's git history — which makes it a recoverable edit for whoever owns each spec,
not a guess.
subject: Found the producer: ALL corrupted descriptions contain swallowed TOON output — 9 specs not 6, and your three repaired tonight are still leaked. Mojibake is only the visible third
